note: Work: the Labour Act [Chapter 28:01] (Acts 16/1985 to 11/2023, Veritas's consolidated text of 16 September 2025), section 11(1): no employer may employ a person under sixteen otherwise than as an apprentice, nor an apprentice under thirteen (section 11(1) as amended by Act 5 of 2015); 13 to 15 may do work that is part of school or vocational training (section 11(3)). The Act makes no exception for performers, so the form holds them barred below sixteen (my reading). Majority: on 2026-10-31 the Constitution's copy on Veritas was a scanned PDF with no text, and no copy of the Legal Age of Majority Act was found (ZimLII and Parliament put this client behind Cloudflare); it was left null. On 2026-11-03 ZimLII's search returned the General Law Amendment Act [Chapter 8:07], s. 15 (the Legal Age of Majority Act 1982 became it): majority at eighteen after 10 December 1982, held. Service: Veritas lists the Defence Act [Chapter 11:02], not read; no conscription law was found; left null. Veritas is a Zimbabwean legal information trust reproducing the Acts as gazetted. Read again 2026-11-03: ZimLII's search returned s. 11(1) of the Labour Act as consolidated to 31 December 2016 (no employer shall employ as an apprentice anyone under sixteen), a search snippet and so a lead, not a source; the working age still rests on Veritas's consolidation (Parliament's site and ZimLII's document pages sit behind a bot check). On 2026-11-03 the register's ZimLII source, which had been cited as primary, was cited as secondary: it is the Zimbabwe Legal Information Institute's copy of the Act, and a legal information institute's copy isn't the state's channel (the lead's ruling of that night); the state's own copies (parlzim.gov.zw 403, zec.org.zw connection reset) weren't reached, so the age of majority stays at second hand.

sources.title: Veritas Zimbabwe: Labour Act [Chapter 28:01] (consolidated, 16 September 2025)
sources.said: (b) otherwise than as an apprentice who is under the age of sixteen years.

sources.title: General Law Amendment Act [Chapter 8:07], s. 15, consolidated to 31 December 2016 (ZimLII; its search returns the text, the page /akn/zw/act/1879/8/eng@2016-12-31 sitting behind a Cloudflare check)
sources.said: 15. Reduction of age of majority from 21 to 18 years [...] after the 10th December, 1982, a person shall attain the legal age of majority on attaining eighteen
